So a cell colored 4 moves up to row 1, one colored 8 moves down toward row 13, and so on for the left and right borders.

I'm going through each labeled cell and computing its destination, discarding colors 3, 6, and 7 since they don't correspond to any border, then assembling the resulting grid with all the relocated cells.
